_meta.note: Five-model coherence scenarios for CUNY EPHS PhD program NDC analysis. Pi model: operational balance across all 7 phases (chain avg 85.7). Phi model: proportional value distribution (entry-to-exit ratio). Sqrt2 model: structural handoff efficiency between phases. Ln2 model: growth and learning transformation across the pipeline. E model: financial abstraction and resource leverage (partially measured via funding/stipend data not yet available).

pi.label: pi
pi.description: Operational coherence: average balance across all 7 phases of the academic pipeline

phi.label: phi
phi.description: Proportional coherence: distribution of value across phases; whether the program's resource investment is proportional to its output intensity

sqrt2.label: sqrt2
sqrt2.description: Structural coherence: custody and handoff efficiency between pipeline phases (admissions to foundation, coursework to candidacy, candidacy to dissertation, dissertation to placement)

ln2.label: ln2
ln2.description: Growth coherence: learning transformation across the pipeline; whether knowledge accumulation compounds efficiently from foundation through dissertation to graduate output

e.label: e
e.description: Abstract (financial) coherence: funding adequacy, stipend structure, and resource leverage. Score is 0 (unmeasured) because funding data is not available from public sources; requires access to CUNY SPH financial aid and stipend records.
